review_locator: PMCID:PMC4713724, WNT-5A: signaling and functions in health and disease; PMID:20359892, Cell/tissue-tropic functions of Wnt5a signaling
primary_title: The receptor tyrosine kinase Ror2 is involved in non-canonical Wnt5a/JNK signalling pathway
decision_basis: The reviews identify ROR2 as a noncanonical WNT5A receptor; the cited primary study demonstrates WNT5A binding to the ROR2 cysteine-rich domain and ROR2/WNT5A-dependent JNK and morphogenetic responses.
limitations_preserved: Preserve ROR2 CRD and FZD/coreceptor context, noncanonical WNT5A signaling and developmental model; no SCI-specific transfer.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6027460, Semaphorin 3C and Its Receptors in Cancer and Cancer Stem-Like Cells; PMCID:PMC6387194, Class-3 Semaphorins and Their Receptors
primary_title: SEMA3C drives cancer growth by transactivating multiple receptor tyrosine kinases via Plexin B1
decision_basis: The reviews identify Plexin-B1 as a SEMA3C receptor in a context-dependent semaphorin receptor network; the cited primary study reports SEMA3C-Plexin-B1 cell-surface association, receptor-dependent RTK activation and prostate-cancer cell growth.
limitations_preserved: Preserve secreted/processed SEMA3C, NRP1/2 dependence and cancer-cell context; do not infer a universal semaphorin receptor complex or CNS/SCI relay.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4537816, Signaling mechanism of the netrin-1 receptor DCC in axon guidance; PMCID:PMC8655782, Multiple Functions of Draxin/Netrin-1 Signaling
primary_title: Draxin Inhibits Axonal Outgrowth through the Netrin Receptor DCC; Structural Basis for Draxin-Modulated Axon Guidance and Fasciculation by Netrin-1 through DCC
decision_basis: The reviews identify DCC as a functionally important Draxin receptor; the cited primary studies demonstrate subnanomolar Draxin-DCC binding, structural DCC-domain engagement and DCC-dependent neurite/growth-cone effects.
limitations_preserved: Preserve Draxin as a distinct netrin-receptor ligand, DCC Ig-domain binding and developmental axon-guidance context; no CNS injury-state or terminal-TF claim.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4537816, Signaling mechanism of the netrin-1 receptor DCC in axon guidance; PMCID:PMC8655782, Multiple Functions of Draxin/Netrin-1 Signaling
primary_title: Draxin Inhibits Axonal Outgrowth through the Netrin Receptor DCC
decision_basis: The reviews report Draxin binding across the netrin-receptor family; the cited primary receptor screen detects Draxin binding to Neogenin-expressing cells but does not establish a Neogenin-specific intracellular relay.
limitations_preserved: Binding-only Neogenin receptor-screen result; preserve receptor-family and species/assay limits and do not infer Neogenin-specific guidance relay.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4537816, Signaling mechanism of the netrin-1 receptor DCC in axon guidance; PMCID:PMC8655782, Multiple Functions of Draxin/Netrin-1 Signaling
primary_title: Draxin Inhibits Axonal Outgrowth through the Netrin Receptor DCC
decision_basis: The reviews report Draxin binding to DSCAM among netrin-receptor candidates; the cited primary receptor screen detects Draxin binding to DSCAM-expressing cells without establishing DSCAM-specific downstream guidance function.
limitations_preserved: Binding-only receptor-screen result; preserve DSCAM/netrin-receptor context and do not infer a DSCAM-specific intracellular or SCI relay.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2768972, The netrin protein family; PMCID:PMC4537816, Signaling mechanism of the netrin-1 receptor DCC in axon guidance
primary_title: DSCAM is a netrin receptor that collaborates with DCC in mediating turning responses to netrin-1
decision_basis: The reviews identify DSCAM as a netrin-1 receptor that collaborates with DCC; the cited primary study demonstrates netrin-1 binding to DSCAM-expressing cells and DSCAM-dependent commissural axon turning/growth toward the midline.
limitations_preserved: Preserve DSCAM/DCC combinatorial receptor topology and developmental commissural-axon context; no isolated DSCAM kinase/adaptor or SCI claim.
